question: Chholiya dance form is associated with _____ state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Chholiya **is a traditional dance form originating from the **Kumaon region of Uttarakhand**, India.
 
• It is primarily performed during wedding processions, as well as other festive occasions and religious ceremonies.
 
• The dance involves intricate swordplay and is performed by men dressed in traditional warrior attire, symbolizing the valor and martial spirit of the Kumao
